create.name: Jilani Cordelia
create.bio:
Jilani Cordelia, also known as Jilani Cordelia Prescott, is a Sufi teacher and musician who lives near Hebden Bridge in West Yorkshire, where her family home, the Heart Centre, doubles as a small retreat house. A classically trained musician, she joined the Dances of Universal Peace as a viola player in 1997, started leading them in 2005 and became a certified leader in 2008; she now mentors new leaders and has co-run a UK leader training since 2017. She received initiation in the Sufi Ruhaniat International, the Western Sufi order that traces back to Hazrat Inayat Khan and Samuel Lewis, in 2007, joined its teaching circle in 2016 and sits on its board of trustees.

Her way in is through music, breath and movement rather than doctrine. With her musical partner Salik she leads free weekly Sufi gatherings on Zoom with chanting, body prayer and live guitar and viola; she also holds Rumi poetry evenings with zikr and guides a small number of students on the Sufi path, asking only voluntary dana. Beyond that she leads residential retreats in Britain, a New Year week at Findhorn and pilgrimages abroad, offers SoulWork sessions and the Ruhaniat's God Is Breath study course.

courses.title: Crossing the Threshold: A New Year Celebration in Song and Dance
courses.description: Six days at Findhorn across the turn of the year, co-led with the musician Barbara Swetina. The week centres on the Dances of Universal Peace, with singing, story, ritual and time for reflection, and joins the community's New Year's Eve in the Universal Hall.
courses.price: From £360 GBP (programme fee; accommodation and meals extra)

courses.title: Khankah of the Heart Retreat: The Illuminated Souls
courses.description: A residential Sufi weekend at Wistaston Hall near Crewe, co-led with Shamsia Sandra Sunfire, drawing on the Illuminated Souls of Hazrat Inayat Khan's invocation. Open to newcomers and long-time practitioners, with meals included and a sliding scale.

courses.title: Caravan to the Mother Roots of Devotion in India
courses.description: A group pilgrimage through northern India, co-led with Jahanara Mangus and Waduda Welsh, visiting temples, ashrams, dargahs and gurdwaras and joining the 100th Urs of Hazrat Inayat Khan in Delhi. Sections can be booked separately; flights are not included.
courses.price: From $500 USD / £370 GBP (Urs Caravan); Northern Caravan Retreat $1,900 USD / £1,400 GBP

courses.title: Poetry, Presence and Remembrance: Rumi Café Nights
courses.description: Evening gatherings in different venues with readings from Rumi and other mystic poets, live music, Sufi conversation and group chanting of zikr. Dates are listed in her calendar.
courses.price: £10 GBP in advance, £15 GBP on the door

courses.title: God Is Breath
courses.description: A set of three year-long study and practice courses from the Sufi Ruhaniat lineage, created by Murshid Wali Ali Meyer, which she guides in small groups. New groups open between levels; interest can be registered through her site.

free_resources.title: Sufi Group – Tuesdays
free_resources.description: A free weekly Zoom gathering on Tuesday evenings with Sufi chants and body prayers set to live guitar and viola. Each practice is taught from the start, so newcomers can join in; donations are welcome.

free_resources.title: Songs of One Breath – Fridays
free_resources.description: A free Friday afternoon session online sharing chants, breath practices and body prayers from a range of traditions. Recordings of past sessions are on her YouTube channel.

flags: Found through Findhorn (Crossing the Threshold, 28 Dec 2026 to 3 Jan 2027, a partner programme run with Barbara Swetina); Findhorn is not a Spiritpedia listing, so teaches_at is empty and the programme is an offering.

Base from her Dances of Universal Peace UK leader profile ('the Heart Centre, a small retreat centre near Hebden Bridge in West Yorkshire'); her own site says only 'the misty Pennine hills of northern England'.
Email jilanicordelia@gmail.com is published as a mailto link on her Khankah retreat and dance-training pages; her contact page hides its address behind JavaScript and was not decoded.

Her YouTube and Facebook are shared with Salik, her musical partner (the DUP UK page names her husband as Robert; whether Salik is the same person is not stated), so the tier counts no followers; the videos are recordings of their joint Zoom gatherings in which she leads.
Listed as 'Jilani Cordelia', the name she uses on her site and at Findhorn; she also appears as Jilani Cordelia Prescott.
The India caravan is co-led and booked through a third-party JotForm; dates span 19 Jan to 15 Feb 2027 across several sections.
